paper.title_en: Kerr stability in the full subextremal range
paper.abstract_en: In the present paper, we extend the results in the sequence of works \cite{KS-GCM1} \cite{KS-GCM2} \cite{KS:Kerr} by Sergiu Klainerman and the author, \cite{GKS22} by Elena Giorgi, Sergiu Klainerman and the author, and \cite{Shen} by Dawei Shen from the slowly rotating regime $|a|\ll m$ to the full subextremal range $|a|<m$, thereby completing the proof of the Kerr stability conjecture. The restriction $|a|\ll m$ enters in fact only through the estimates for wave equations and for the Bianchi system established in \cite{GKS22}. To remove this restriction, we crucially rely on the two companion papers \cite{MaSz24} \cite{MaSz26} by Siyuan Ma and the author, in which we prove energy-Morawetz estimates respectively for the inhomogeneous scalar wave equation and for inhomogeneous Teukolsky equations on perturbations of Kerr with $|a|<m$. Additionally, some of the results of the present paper are proved in our companion paper \cite{Sze}.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文宣称在全次极值范围 |a|<m 内完成了Kerr稳定性猜想的证明，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞微扰理论的核心问题；其论证依赖于同一作者系列前期工作及两篇伴随论文中建立的能量-Morawetz估计，理论深度与方法学信号均很强；论文较新且零引用属中性，不扣分。
decision.title_zh: 全次极值范围内的Kerr稳定性
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们将Sergiu Klainerman与作者本人系列工作\cite{KS-GCM1}\cite{KS-GCM2}\cite{KS:Kerr}、Elena Giorgi、Sergiu Klainerman与作者本人合著的\cite{GKS22}以及Dawei Shen的\cite{Shen}中的结果从慢旋转区域 $|a|\ll m$ 推广到全次极值范围 $|a|<m$，从而完成了Kerr稳定性猜想的证明。事实上，限制 $|a|\ll m$ 仅通过\cite{GKS22}中建立的波方程估计与Bianchi系统估计进入。为移除该限制，我们关键性地依赖于Siyuan Ma与作者本人的两篇伴随论文\cite{MaSz24}\cite{MaSz26}，在其中我们分别证明了 $|a|<m$ 的Kerr扰动上非齐次标量波方程与非齐次Teukolsky方程的能量-Morawetz估计。此外，本文的部分结果在我们的伴随论文\cite{Sze}中得到证明。
